findings.evidence: `normalizedCubicalChainComplex` and `singularCubicalHomologyIso` are declared under `[Ring k]` in `Comparison/Basic.lean`, while `MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv` only requires semiring/module structure; the first genuinely commutative-dependent operation in this file is the bilinear multiplication proof at `loopZeroChainToGroupAlgebra_mul`.
findings.fix: Use `[Ring R]` for the additive classification and chain-map results, introducing `[CommRing R]` only for `loopZeroChainToGroupAlgebra_mul` and algebra-hom formulations (or state naturality using `MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainLinearMap`).
findings.issue: The file-wide `[CommRing R]` over-specializes `loopHomologyZero`, its isomorphism/projection, generator and boundary formulas, and `loopHomologyZeroπ_map`; these additive H₀ results naturally work over any `[Ring R]`.

summary: The coefficient hypothesis is unnecessarily global: most of the new H₀ classification only needs a ring, while commutativity is needed for the bilinear Pontryagin-product interface.
